settings.title: Dispatch
settings.body: Orders placed before 2pm Eastern on a business day are picked the same day. Everything else goes the next.

settings.title: Rates
settings.body: Standard, US: 3 to 5 business days, $8. Express, US: 1 to 2 business days, $18. Free: any US order over $125. International: 6 to 10 business days, $22.

settings.title: International
settings.body: Canada today, with duties payable on delivery. The rest of the world through the international rate above.

settings.title: Tracking
settings.body: A tracking link is emailed the moment the parcel is scanned by the carrier.

settings.title: Returns
settings.body: Thirty days from delivery, unworn with tags on. Shipping is covered both ways within the US.

settings.title: Faults
settings.body: Email hello@wearryvt.com with your order number and a photograph. We replace or refund, your choice.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.lede: When it leaves, what it costs, and how to send it back.
